name: Nest Alpha Vault LP
oneLiner: inALPHA is Nest Credit's NAV-priced dollar vault token, holding private and structured credit positions with nTBILL and liquid stablecoin buffers.
collateral: Diversified portfolio of tokenized RWAs from institutional asset managers plus private-credit and trade-finance positions from accredited protocol partners, with a liquidity buffer of yield-bearing stablecoins and an nTBILL (Nest Treasury) allocation.
pegMechanism: Vault LP token whose value targets a dollar base but can appreciate or drift with strategy NAV rather than functioning as a hard 1:1 redeemable stablecoin

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: Nest publishes inALPHA through its own product and documentation on Ethereum and Plume, with no external bridge protocol evidence resolved. The reviewed route is issuer/protocol-native issuance rather than a third-party bridge.

reserveReview.reviewer: SOL-III Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: The current first-party Nest positions capture reports 91.4% aggregate private and structured credit, 4.7% nTBILL, 2.3% USDC, and 1.6% pUSD for the Alpha Vault. The exact four-row envelope preserves the three tracked liquid or fund dependencies while treating the aggregate credit sleeve as a classified but not falsely decomposed borrower basket.
